criteria.description: Returns the requested JSON fields with the exact answer token and diagnosis label.
criteria.name: Output ledger
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for a valid JSON object with one missing ledger field; award 1 point for a readable but incomplete structured answer.

criteria.description: Uses the package anchor date and the two lexicographic point-sample JSON records.
criteria.name: Locked date and point records
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for the correct date with one point source omitted; award 1 point for finding point records but using the wrong date.

criteria.description: Extracts 0.50 mm and 1.24 mm from the matching date fields without changing units.
criteria.name: Point precipitation extraction
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for one correct point value; award 1 point for correct fields with a transcription error.

criteria.description: Finds the three grid-summary precipitation means and computes grid_mean_precip_mm = 0.32.
criteria.name: Grid summary mean
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for two correct grid inputs with the right formula; award 1 point for recognizing the grid-summary keys.

criteria.name: Gap and wet count
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1.5 points for either value alone.

criteria.description: Applies the threshold and tolerance rule to produce point_split_grid_dry_consensus.
criteria.name: Threshold diagnosis
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for the correct split and grid-dry states with a wrong token; award 1 point for a correct threshold comparison but incomplete final label.
